Learn moreSign in Comments 2 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Why are the Chagos Islands at the heart of a global power struggle? 51Likes3,377ViewsFeb 262026 The Chagos Islands, a group of seven atolls, have been a British territory since 1965. Diego Garcia, the largest island, is now home to a joint UK-US military base, a crucial hub for transatlantic power. After years of legal battles, Mauritius is set to gain control of the archipelago, while leasing Diego Garcia to the UK on a 99-year lease, with options to extend. But Washington has called the deal unacceptable.
